sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Abysseram is a physical-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (S), Agility (B).

sections.title: Is the Abysseram Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (S), Agility (B). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
